title: Human-approved Hot Chips 2026 public research update
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's 2026-08-31 request to implement the previously discussed Hot Chips 2026 update: use both supplied reports as discovery leads, inspect the official program and additional public sources, inventory presenting organizations, map conference technologies to existing catalogs and update evidence-backed roadmap timing. Bound scope to conference technologies and direct dependencies, not every product of every vendor. Record inaccessible sources and unresolved discrepancies as Coverage Gaps. This records publication scope, not scientific approval or independent Consensus. Preserve provisional single-agent/single-model status. Do not bypass restricted access, enable unattended automation, merge the review PR or deploy production.
